title: container.adf.extract result
description: What would be written, and whether it was. A `prepared` response and a `conflict` response both carry the plan with `committed: false`; the envelope's status says which happened. A `success` carries the same plan with `committed: true`, so the response documents exactly what is now on disk.

committed.description: Whether the plan was written. False for `prepare` and for a refused commit.

unreadable.description: Members the container names and this build could not recover: a data chain it could not walk, a block that is not the kind the table claims. Empty for a sound container. A damaged member is **absent** from `plan` rather than written short or zero-filled, so the plan stays a statement of complete files and this is where the loss is recorded. Reported alongside a CONTAINER_MEMBER_UNREADABLE diagnostic per member.

path.description: The path it would have been written to, `/`-separated.

reason.description: Why it could not be read, as the reader that refused it said.
